title: Natural Transformation
author: Franziska Müller
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uyzexx6

steps.title: Induce tfoX Expression
steps.instruction: Grow a strain containing tfoX regulated by an IPTG inducible promoter in LBv2 medium with Carbenicillin.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 3 mL of LBv2 medium containing 100 ug/ml Carbenicillin.
Add 100 uM IPTG to the medium.
Incubate at 30 °C with shaking from 12:00 to 16:00 (4 hours).

steps.title: Perform Natural Transformation
steps.instruction: Mix pre-culture with IPTG and add transformation DNA for static incubation.

substeps.instruction: Mix 3.5 µL of pre-culture with 350 µL of 28g/l XIO containing 100 uM IPTG.
Add 50 ng of transformation DNA to the mixture.
Prepare a control sample without the addition of transformation DNA.
Incubate statically at 30 °C from 04:00 to 06:00 (2 hours).

steps.title: Recover Cells
steps.instruction: Allow cells to recover after transformation.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of LBv2 medium to the reaction.
Incubate at 30 °C with shaking for 2 hours.

steps.title: Plate and Incubate
steps.instruction: Plate the reaction mixture onto selective agar and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Plate the complete reaction onto LBv2 agar plates containing the antibiotic corresponding to the transformation DNA.
Incubate the plates for 12 hours at 37 °C.
